Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Sync Status & Pet Recovery Clarity: Redesign sign-in layout into a split screen highlighting cloud pet save status and account persistence details. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Preview Flow: Add interactive pet preview components during friend selection to let users test animations and appearance before finalizing. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long duration (1017s mean), plus 3 support emails about custom pet generation issues.)
2: [finish, redesign] Interactive Pet Control Checklist: Redesign the final welcome screen into a checklist tutorial teaching users how to hide, summon, and talk to their desktop pet. (why: Support had 3 confusion reports about pet controls, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity & Quality Hints: Display explicit photo upload guidance and format hints to prevent upload failures and bad custom renders. (why: 3 support tickets cited failed custom pet generation or bad-looking results.)
4: [home, wait_info] Setup Progress & Desktop Tips Carousel: Show dynamic setup progress updates and a pet tip carousel while the pet assets download and prepare. (why: The waiting screen has a very long mean time (2336s) and causes user drop-off.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Structured Path Grid Comparison: Switch path selection to a structured grid layout clearly comparing preset adoptable pets vs custom pet creation. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a 514s mean time, showing user decision hesitation.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Stalling Recovery Helper: Add a fallback notification hint offering alternative sign-in options if the screen stalls or takes long to load. (why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to appear.)

scores.note: Sign-in has 27.1% drop-off and strong support volume (8 emails) regarding sync/persistence.

Finish step loses 35.2% of users; interactive checklist helps clear up feature confusion reported in support.
Targets adoption drop-off by clarifying photo uploads; lightweight hints are easy to add.
Home step drop-off is low (18.7%), but long mean wait time (2336s) makes tips carousel helpful for retention.
High mean time (514s) indicates hesitation, but drop-off is moderate (23.8%) without support tickets.
